A–     Pay cash wages of $1,700 or more in 2011 to any one Withhold and pay social security and Medicare taxes.
       household employee.                                  • The taxes are 13.3% of cash wages.

Note. If neither A nor B above applies, you do not need to pay any federal employment taxes. But you may still need to
pay state employment taxes.
